purpose: Operational portfolio fixture built only from authoritative BOE obligations already validated in Convenio Watch. It tests whether the portfolio engine produces a useful daily queue without inventing calendar precision.

obligations.agreementName: Convenio colectivo general de trabajo de la industria textil y de la confección 2024-2026
obligations.evidenceNote: BOE states affected companies must make the 2026 increases effective before 2026-04-30, subject to the stated inaplicacion exception.

obligations.agreementName: Convenio colectivo estatal para las empresas de publicidad
obligations.evidenceNote: BOE requires three equal non-consolidating payments: within Q4 2026, before 2027-04-01, and before 2027-10-01.

obligations.agreementName: XIX Convenio colectivo estatal de empresas de consultoría, tecnologías de la información y estudios de mercado y de la opinión pública
obligations.evidenceNote: BOE states arrears must be paid no later than the payroll following the month of BOE publication. The employer payroll calendar is required to resolve a calendar date safely.

obligations.agreementName: Convenio colectivo nacional para empresas de servicios de campo para actividades de reposición y servicios de marketing operacional 2026-2029
obligations.evidenceNote: If final 2026 CPI exceeds 3.5%, capped at 3.75%, the agreement creates a non-consolidating compensatory payment in the payroll following publication of final CPI.
